Bound resources split into granted vs denied for Tools / Knowledge / Skills

cards.title: Access resolution
items: base scope by mode; then canUse(accessPolicy) can flip status to policy_denied
principal carries no subject at invoke → private resources fail closed
blocked short-circuits all grants; denied resources show struck-through

cards.title: Mock seams vs real contract
items: send() is synchronous state append — no model call, no streaming
decodeToken is a deterministic substring decode (user/svc, grc/labs, full/partial) — a caller resolves to role=executer only
Real path: POST /v1/agents/:id/invoke (caller token, SSE) — playground preview & published invoke share one body + code path (runtime.invoke)
Server resolves effective access = agent config ∩ caller grants ∩ tenant (RLS) ∩ resource policy
